feeding.title: Feeding Guidance
feeding.tip: Keep feeding times consistent and follow the food portions recommended by your veterinarian or pet food provider.

walk.title: Exercise Guidance
walk.tip: Choose a walk duration and intensity that matches the pet's age, health, breed, and normal activity level.

medication.title: Medication Safety
medication.tip: Give medication only according to instructions from a licensed veterinarian. PawPal does not recommend medication names or dosages.

appointment.title: Appointment Preparation
appointment.tip: Prepare relevant medical records, current medications, symptoms, and questions before the veterinary appointment.

grooming.title: Grooming Guidance
grooming.tip: Use pet-safe grooming products and adjust grooming frequency based on coat type, skin condition, and veterinarian recommendations.

other.title: General Pet Care
other.tip: Use a consistent routine and contact a licensed veterinarian when a pet shows concerning or unusual symptoms.
